sentences: Guess what I did on Saturday?
I went to a party at my friend's house and there was a big cake shaped like a guitar.
It even had strings made of liquorice.
Did you do anything this week?
There was big lights, the coloured ones.
What did you do at the disco?
What did you and Kayla and Ruby do?
Your glitter top with the star.
It goes all different colours when you rub it.
You must have felt so proud wearing that.
Kayla had one too but hers was a heart.
Have you been to a disco?
A long time ago, when I was at school.
My mum picked me up and we got chips on the way home.
How was it when it finished?
I was a bit sad when it finished because I wanted it to keep going.
You wanted it to keep going.
Let me tell you your story back.
There was a disco at school, in the hall, with the coloured lights.
You were there with Kayla and Ruby and Mr Dean.
You wore your glitter top with the star, because it's your best one.
It was the best one ever.
At the end, Mum picked you up and you got chips on the way home, and you were a bit sad when it finished because you wanted it to keep going.
And Kayla had a heart on hers.

It even had strings made of liquorice. Did you do anything this week? Child. There was the disco. Therapist. A disco! Where was it? Child. At school. In the hall. There was big lights, the coloured ones. Therapist. Coloured lights in the hall. Who was there? Child. Me and Kayla and Ruby. And Mr Dean. He's our teacher. Therapist. Mr Dean, your teacher. What did you do at the disco? Child. I don't know. Therapist. You don't know. Have a think. What did you and Kayla and Ruby do? Child. Um. I wore my glitter top. The one with the star. Therapist. Your glitter top with the star. Child. Cos it's my best one. It goes all different colours when you rub it. Therapist. Wow. Child. It changes colour. Therapist. You must have felt so proud wearing that. Child. Kayla had one too but hers was a heart. Therapist. A heart one. What was the disco like? Child. It was the best. The best one ever. Therapist. The best one ever! Have you been to a disco? Child. A long time ago, when I was at school. Therapist. What happened at the end? Child. My mum picked me up and we got chips on the way home. Therapist. Chips on the way home. How was it when it finished? Child. I was a bit sad when it finished because I wanted it to keep going. Therapist. You wanted it to keep going. Let me tell you your story back. There was a disco at school, in the hall, with the coloured lights. You were there with Kayla and Ruby and Mr Dean. You wore your glitter top with the star, because it's your best one. Child. It was the best one ever. Therapist. At the end, Mum picked you up and you got chips on the way home, and you were a bit sad when it finished because you wanted it to keep going. And Kayla had a heart. And Kayla had a heart on hers. Thank you, Poppy.

written.summary: The child told about a disco at school in the hall with big coloured lights. They mentioned being there with Kayla, Ruby, and Mr Dean. The child wore a glitter top with a star that changes colour and said it was their best one. They also mentioned Kayla had a heart-shaped glitter top which she said was the best. The child said the disco was the best one ever and that their mum picked them up and they got chips on the way home. They also said they were a bit sad when it finished because they wanted it to keep going.
